question: I withdrew from a course this semester. Will the W grade on my transcript lower my QPA?
expected_answer: No — withdrawn courses receive a W grade, which is not factorable (does not enter the QPA calculation). However, the W-graded course does still count toward your total units enrolled for the semester, meaning it affects your full-time/part-time status but not your GPA.
reasoning_type: Grade type policy — QPA impact assessment
common_mistake: Assuming any grade on the transcript, including W, impacts QPA; confusing total enrolled units (affected by W) with factorable units (not affected by W)
needs_verification: Confirm CMU-Q policy that W grades are non-factorable and do not impact QPA
Confirm that W grades do count toward the semester's total enrolled units for full-time status purposes
Confirm the withdrawal deadline (typically 10th week of classes) after which withdrawal is not allowed
